title: Tamarfen Ceramics LLC v. Rillstead Tableware LLC
forum: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota

timeline.event: Client released its constellation teapot pattern
Rival released an allegedly matching design
Federal copyright case filed; discovery later opened
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for thirteen days after signing

documents.title: Interrogatories with mailing certificate
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Rival mailed its first interrogatories four days before the client workplan was signed. They ask for the constellation design history and sales channels. Ordinary federal response period; no extension or special scheduling order.

documents.title: Design chronology
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The studio notebook records a crooked comet sketch followed by a five-star handle design. Preserve the source versions while preparing answers.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 2: Counsel will deliver draft interrogatory responses and a collection checklist. Delivery is due thirteen calendar days after the client workplan was signed. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of interrogatory response draft

clientFacing.status: The other side has asked written questions about your design.
nextSteps: Collect the sketch versions and sales totals.
Check the discovery response draft for accuracy.
